newsitem.title: USA: St. Paul Cos Inc Q3 net off, revenues rise.
newsitem.headline: St. Paul Cos Inc Q3 net off, revenues rise.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 Q3 results include about $65 million in pretax catastrophe losses from Hurricane Fran on the East Coast and storms and flooding in the Midwest and Southwest.
1996 Q3 reflects completion of the purchase from the Allstate Corp of Northbrook Holdings Inc, which underwrites commercial property-liability insurance throughout the United States.

1996 Q3 results also include loss from a plan to disinvest a significant portion of St. Paul's holdings in Minet, its London-based insurance brokerage operation. St. Paul estimates that this disinvestment will result in a pretax loss of $250 million, which has been recorded in the third quarter. Since the company's federal income tax carrying value in Minet is substantially higher than its book carrying value, St. Paul said it has recognized an estimated income tax benefit of $266 million in third-quarter operating earnings.
Third quarter net includes realized investment gains equal to $0.27 a share in 1996 and $0.19 in 1995.
Nine months net includes realized investment gains equal to $0.94 a share in 1996 and $0.28 in 1995.
